g.title: Stored-format and complete-candidate validation over fresh five-kind records and deliberately malformed inputs; this group concerns data meaning rather than filesystem publication.
Recorded dependencies; execution tooling retains its existing contract owner.
The shared store and public advanced adapter operate on real private filesystems; controlled faults, competing processes and before/after bytes expose transaction and recovery behavior.
